'''RamapoCon III Team Tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG team held in Ramapo College, New Jersey on 9 June 2001. It is known from Kim Caton's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2453">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-13-ramapocon-3-kim-catond2453/ ramapocon-3-kim-caton], DeckTech (Kimberly "Arwen Even*" Caton, 13 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-13-ramapocon-3-kim-catond2453/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[RamapoCon III]].

* '''Date:''' 9 June 2001
* '''Site:''' Ramapo College, New Jersey
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Winner:''' Shhh.... Grandma (team: [[Clint Hays]] and others)<ref name="tr-d2515" />
